plan_rule.note: standing round-61 rule: gate panel-scale commitments on a pre-dispatch rate measurement. Measured by two 256-token census calls plus one full-cap calibration dispatch on the anchor cell, all before the gate is frozen; the selected panel is a function of the measured rate, not of mid-run conditions. Worst-case panel arithmetic: the full plan is 16,384 completion tokens and the trimmed plan 12,288, against the frozen 3,000 s dispatch budget

T4_task_complexity_not_the_wall.statement: the ladder item at any tested depth is a two-path BFS problem in NC1 (128 facts at k = 64); the task stays computationally trivial while the observed walls sit at output budget (2048 cap, round 52) and step position (j >= 40, round 59), so the wall is a length-generalization and output-budget property of the deployment, not a task-complexity limit

tier_rule: panel state drives the verdict tier: panel_delivered (all four endpoint cells recorded), panel_partial (two or three of four recorded), panel_starved (one or fewer recorded; P1 stays owed and the measured rate is the record). The P1 criterion carries the discriminator count and the reading; a controls_invalid firing downgrades the P1 evaluation to uncertified. The verdict is recorded against the dispatched plan only; a cell that did not dispatch is not reported as a result.
